title: Negotiating and persuading / Gaaffii fi dhaga'uu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, gaaffii fi dhaga'uu kana malee, wanti 'kan itti danda'an' jechuu akkas akka 'itti danda'u' jechuudha. Akkasumas, 'kan itti danda'an' jechuu akkas akka 'itti danda'u' jechuudha. Afaan Ingiliffa, B2 kanarraa akka 'would', 'could', 'might' fi 'I was wondering if...' jechuu barbaachisaa ta'e kan danda'a.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffa B2-n gaaffii fi dhaga'uu: 1) Fannoo barbaachisaa: 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Fannoo adabbi: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Fannoo gaaffii: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Fannoo itti dhaga'uu: 'What if we...?', 'How about...? + -ing', 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Fannoo hojii: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (hojii lamaansaa). Dhaga'uun, fannoon 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...' jechuudha.

common_error.correct: I suggest that we wait until next week.

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / Biraa fi qindeessan guddaan godhuu fi cabsuu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, 'kana malee' kana 'haqa malee' jechuu fi 'haqa' jechuun cabsuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii, biraa fi qindeessan guddaan godhuu waaqattarraa 'the reason being', 'due to', 'given that', fi shartoteessaas 'if... then...' hin kennamne. 'According to my opinion' (kan qabiyyee tokko dha) hin amanu; 'in my opinion' jechuu dha. Afaan Oromoitti wote, fiilichaa moddaalee (would, could) biraa qindeessuufi qajeelfama kennamuu miti.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii biraa fi qindeessan guddaan godhuu: 1) Seenaa biraa: 'In my view', 'From my perspective', 'I would argue that', 'It seems to me that'. 2) Cabsuu: 'The reason for this is', 'This is due to', 'Given that', 'Considering that'. 3) Sirrii: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'While it is true that...', 'Nevertheless'. 4) Shartoteessa sirrii: 'If... then', 'Unless...', 'Provided that...'. 5) Sirrii umrii-quu'ee: 'This leads to', 'As a result', 'Consequently'. Maqaa B2: Qindaa sirrii fi cabhero afaan guddaa miti.

concept_examples.text: I would argue that investing in education yields long-term benefits, given that it improves social mobility.
concept_examples.translation: Haqa malee barumsa ta'e uffataa faayidaa uffataa godhaa ta'u malee, haqa akkas jedha qophii umrii sirrii kennitan.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Mana lammi goonee keessa kennu
bridge: Afaan Espaanii keessatti, mana lammi goonee keessa kennu ‘habría + participio’ kana ‘hubiera + participio’ jedhaa ta’u malee, Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti sirrii tokko ilaalchisee: ‘would have + past participle’ dhumaatiin tokkoo fi ‘had + past participle’ mul’inee (third conditional) kennu. Akkasumas, ‘si habría’ akkuma ‘if would have’ jechuu qajeelfama tokko ta’e, Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti mul’iin ‘would’ hin qabnu. Akkasumas, Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti ‘might have’ fi ‘could have’ dubbii haasa’aa kana qabduu godhuu kennu, Afaan Espaanii keessatti ‘podría haber’ kana ‘quizás habría’ jechuudha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti mana lammi goonee keessa kennu ‘third conditional’ fi sirrii mirgaa tokko tokko kennu. Sirrii tokkoo: ‘If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle’. Fakkeenya: ‘If I had studied, I would have passed’. Akkasumas, ‘could have’ (qabduu), ‘might have’ (haasa’aa), ‘should have’ (maqaa kana hin miidhamne) kennu. Bara murtii kana gocha gochuu keessatti, ‘wish + past perfect’ (ojalá hubiera) kennu. ‘Would have’ mul’ii ‘if’ keessatti hin kennu. Galataa keessatti, dubbii tokko qabnu: ‘Would you have...?’

title: Discussing abstract concepts / Maqaa tokko tokko haaraa
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa tokko tokko haaraa malee barbaachisuu wajjin, ‘suggest’, ‘recommend’, ‘demand’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘It is essential that...’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa tokko tokko haaraa ‘freedom’ ‘justice’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa tokko tokko haaraa ‘do’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa tokko tokko haaraa ‘which’ ‘that’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘would’, ‘should’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘It is obvious that’, ‘It is worth considering’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha.
rule: Maqaa tokko tokko haaraa afaan Ingilizii keessatti haaraa malee barbaachisuu wajjin, ‘zero article’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘I suggest that she be...’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘It is crucial that he attend’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘In my opinion’, ‘I believe that’, ‘It seems to me that’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘which’ ‘that’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘would’, ‘should’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha. ‘It is obvious that’, ‘It is worth considering’ jechuunis barbaachisuu dha.

title: Expressing complex emotions / Emoshon komplektaa mata dureewwan cabsee
bridge: Afaan Oromo, mana dhaabbata ‘qabda’ jechuu akkasumas mana dhaabbata ‘jaba’ jechuufi dhugaa jechuu hojjeta. Akkasumas, mana dhaabbata ‘miisha’ jechuufi dhugaa jechuu hojjeta. Mana dhaabbata ‘miisha’ jechuu ‘I'm afraid of’ jechuu akkasumas, mana dhaabbata ‘jaba’ jechuu ‘I'm annoyed at’ jechuu hojjeta. Akkasumas, Afaan Oromo, ‘frustrated’ (miisha) jechuu ‘annoyed’ (jaba) jechuu akkasumas, ‘overwhelmed’ (miisha) jechuu dhugaa jechuu hojjeta.
rule: Emoshon komplektaa Afaan Ingilizii keessatti cabsee: 1) Adjektiviifis preposishan dhabaman: 'angry about/at', 'frustrated with', 'disappointed in/with', 'excited about', 'worried about', 'ashamed of', 'proud of'. 2) Fakkeenya ‘feel’ + adjektiviif jechuu ‘feel like’ + gerund jechuufi emoshooni dhaabbachuu. 3) Fiilichaa ‘get’ + adjektiviif jechuu emoshooni walqixxumaa (get frustrated, get overwhelmed). 4) Adjektiviif haala-dhabaa emoshooni komplektaa: 'homesick', 'heartbroken', 'overwhelmed'. 5) Mata dureewwan emoshooni guddaa: 'on cloud nine' (dhugaa), 'down in the dumps' (miisha).

title: Formal Writing: Reports and Emails / Barumsaa fi E-maillu Guuteessa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, barumsaa guuteessi dhiiraa malee qindeessaa fi qindeessuun barbaachisaa ta’ee jecha ta’u godha. Afaan Ingilizii, barumsaa qindeessaa fi barbaachisummaa ta’ee jecha ta’u godha. Akkasumas, ‘I attach’ jedhanii (hoji) ‘Please find attached’ jewaa ‘I have attached’ jechuu miti. Afaan Ingilizii guutettiin ‘would’ fi ‘could’ jedhanii barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u malee, Afaan Oromo ‘Podría’ jedhaa barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha. Akkasumas, Afaan Ingilizii ‘usted’ jewaa barbaachisuu hojjetu qindeessaa fi barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u malee, qindeessaa fi barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha.
rule: Barumsaa fi e-maillu guuteessi Afaan Ingilizii B2 sirrii ta’u malee, barbaachisummaa fi qindeessaa hojii ta’u godha: 1) Barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha: ‘Dear Mr. Smith’, ‘Dear Madam’, ‘Yours sincerely’, ‘Yours faithfully’. 2) Qindeessaa fi barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha: ‘state’ (‘say’ hoji), ‘require’ (‘need’ hoji), ‘I would like to’ (‘I want’ hoji), ‘I am writing to inform you’. 3) Qindeessaa barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha: qindeessaa sirrii ta’u, qindeessaa barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u, fi qindeessaa sirrii ta’u. 4) Qindeessaa hojii ta’u godha: ‘do not’ (‘don’t’ hoji), ‘I would’ (‘I’d’ hoji). 5) Barumsaa: ‘Introduction’, ‘Findings’, ‘Recommendations’, fi ‘It was found that...’ jedhanii qindeessaa hojii ta’u godha. 6) Barbaachisummaa hojii ta’u godha: ‘Could you please...’, ‘I would appreciate...’, ‘Would it be possible to...?’. Afaan Ingilizii guutettiin ‘please’ jedhanii qindeessaa hojii ta’u malee, sirrii ta’u godha.

title: Dealing with Conflict / Nati fardduu fi qorophii itti dhaga'u
bridge: Afaan Espaanii keessatti, nama adda addaa 'Dime qué pasó' jechuu akkasumas 'deberías' kan ta'e hojjetu barbaachisaa fi qorophii itti dhaga'uu argachuu dandeessan. Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti garuu, kan biraa fi kan qajeelfamni barbaachisaa fi hojjetu barbaachisaa hawaasaa ta'uudha. Verbo modaal 'could' fi 'might' akkasumas 'I feel...' jechuun barbaaddaa ta'uudha; 'tienes que' akkasumas 'you must' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'u malee, 'you might want to' akkasumas 'maybe you could' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti barbaachisaa fi hojjetu barbaachisaa hawaasaa ta'u malee, verbo modaal 'could', 'might', 'would' (masalaa 'We could try...') akkasumas 'I feel', 'I think', 'I believe' jechuun barbaaddaa ta'uudha. 'If you..., we could...' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha. 'I understand', 'I see your point' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha. 'I wonder if you could...' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha. 'I'm sorry if that came across the wrong way' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha. 'You are wrong' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'u malee, 'I'm not sure that's accurate' akkasumas 'I see it differently' jechuun barbaachisaa hojjetu ta'uudha.

title: Summarising and Paraphrasing / Gaaffii fi sirrii irra
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, waan sirrii irra deebii ‘yeroo wal akkaataa’ fi ‘gaaffii’ dubbifame, garuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti marri waljiraa hin jiru fi qoodduu essuma yoo ta’e komaa qaban jedhanii jira. Haala malee: afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘in summary’ ‘in short’ ykn ‘to sum up’ duulaa hin taane; fi ‘summarize’ seena kennuun duubatti ta’e. Dhugaa: afaan Oromootti garuu waljiraa barbaachisaa ta’e, afaan Ingilizii keessatti barbaachisaa fi qajeelfama kennuun duubatti ta’e, garuu waljiraa barbaachisaa hin taane.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti gaaffii fi sirrii irra waraana B2, ‘summarize’, ‘paraphrase’, ‘outline’, ‘restate’ jedhamu barbaachisaa fi ‘in other words’, ‘that is’, ‘to put it briefly’, ‘in a nutshell’, ‘to sum up’, ‘in short’, ‘all in all’ fi ‘to recap’ jedhamu waljiraa barbaachisaa qaban ta’u. Godhanii walii dhaga’aa akkasii jedha: [Waljiraa] + [godhanii sirrii irraa kan qaban]. Sirrii irraa ta’u akkasumas godhanii qajeelfama ta’e (haata’u garuu qajeelfamaa kennuun duubatti ta’e ykn godhanii waljiraa barbaachisaa ta’e) garuu mana sirrii irraa hin taane. Fakkeenya: ‘The study reveals a significant increase...’ → ‘In other words, the numbers went up a lot.’ Sirrii sirrii qaban akkasumas ‘The text is about...’ ykn ‘The author argues that...’ jedhamu barbaachisaa qaban ta’u. ‘In summary’ akkasumas afaan Oromootti ‘gaaffii’ jedhamu barbaachisaa hin godhin; ‘in short’ ykn ‘to sum up’ jedhamu barbaachisaa godha. ‘Actually’ (kan ‘tarkaan’ jedhu) barbaachisaa hin taane; sirrii sirrii akkasumas ‘in fact’ ykn ‘actually’ jedhamu barbaachisaa godha.

title: Using Idioms Naturally / Afaan Ingilizii keessatti haala dhaabboluu danda'an godhamu
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'tener' (p. ej., 'tener buena cara') kana malee 'estar' (p. ej., 'estar como una cabra') hin godhanne. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be' (p. ej., 'to be over the moon') hin godhanne. Haala dhaabboluu afaan Oromoota afaan Ingiliziiitti dhaabboluu malees hin qabne akkasumas 'to have a good face' hin jiru; 'to be in a good mood' jechuudha. Akkasumas, afaan Ingilizii keessatti haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be' (p. ej., 'be over the moon') hin godhanne, afaan Oromo keessatti 'estar' kana 'tener' hin godhanne. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'kick the bucket' (hin jiru; 'to die') akkasumas 'pass away' (hin jiru; 'to die') hin godhanne.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti haala dhaabboluu danda'an godhamu akkasii qaba:
1. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'break the ice' (hin jiru; 'to start a conversation') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.
2. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be delighted' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.
3. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'break the ice' (hin jiru; 'to start a conversation') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.
4. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be delighted' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.
5. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be in hot water' (hin jiru; 'to be in trouble') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be in a pickle' (hin jiru; 'to be in trouble') hin qabne.
6. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'it's raining cats and dogs' (hin jiru; 'it's raining heavily') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.
7. Haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'a piece of cake' (hin jiru; 'something easy') hin qabne, haala dhaabboluu akkas umrii tokko tokko ta'ee hojii 'to be over the moon' (hin jiru; 'to be very happy') hin qabne.

common_error.explanation: Akkan akkaan, afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘Se dice que’ akakaa’eera ‘It says that’ kana malee ‘Se says that’ akakaa’eera. Akkan akkaan, afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘It is said that’ akakaa’eera. Akkan akkaan, afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘It + pasiva’ kana malee ‘People/They’ akakaa’eera. Akkan akkaan, afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘to be’ + ‘past participle’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: The data were collected from various sources.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə wɜːr kəˈlɛktɪd frəm ˈveəriəs ˈsɔːsɪz/
examples.translation: Netixxataa kun qindaa isaa ta’e malee mo’ii irra deebii akkan argamu.
examples.note: Afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘ser’ akakaa’eera, akkan akkaan afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘past participle’ fi ‘to be’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: The report was written by our research team.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt wɒz ˈrɪtn baɪ aʊər rɪˈsɜːtʃ tiːm/
examples.translation: Qabxiiwwan kun qindaa isaa ta’e malee mo’ii irra deebii akkan argamu.
examples.note: Afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘by’ akakaa’eera; afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘por’ akakaa’eera.

levels.label: Modal Verbs for Politeness and Probability

examples.original: Could you provide more details about the proposal?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː prəˈvaɪd mɔːr ˈdiːteɪlz əˈbaʊt ðə prəˈpəʊzl/
examples.translation: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera?
examples.note: Afaan Ingilizii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘could’ akakaa’eera ‘can’ akakaa’eera; afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘podría’ akakaa’eera ‘puede’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: The increase in costs may affect our budget.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɪnkriːs ɪn kɒsts meɪ əˈfɛkt aʊə ˈbʌdʒɪt/
examples.translation: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera.
examples.note: ‘May’ qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera; afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘puede’ akakaa’eera, akkan akkaan ‘can’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː hæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz pliːz duː nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə ˈkɒntækt miː/
examples.translation: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera, qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera.
examples.note: Afaan Ingilizii mirkanii qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘do not’ akakaa’eera ‘don’t’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: Furthermore, the results support our initial hypothesis.
examples.phonetic: /ˌfɜːðəˈmɔːr ðə rɪˈzʌlts səˈpɔːrt aʊər ɪˈnɪʃəl haɪˈpɒθɪsɪs/
examples.translation: Akkan akkaan, qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera.
examples.note: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera ‘furthermore’, ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’ akakaa’eera ‘also’ fi ‘but’ akakaa’eera.

examples.original: The implementation of the new policy was completed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi wɒz kəmˈpliːtɪd/
examples.translation: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera.
examples.note: Qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera (‘implement’ → ‘implementation’) qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera; afaan Soomaaliif qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera qajeelaa baraa akakaa’eera.
